why: Test whether contact shadows resolve the observed small-grass readability issue before changing the painted source.
scope: Dry grasses and Cerrado bunchgrass, all three sizes and biome terrains, close-rain zoom 1.8; all three boards individually inspected.
trial: Add contact shadows: dry grasses radius 8, bunchgrass radius 6, opacity .28; include them in bounds.
finding: Base grounding changes slightly but the minimum bunchgrass remains hard to separate from ground. This does not resolve silhouette contrast.
runtimeStatus: All three runtime metadata/renderer trial edits reverted exactly. No visual behavior change shipped. Capture input hashes describe the rejected candidate, not final runtime.
next: Correct painted bunchgrass silhouette contrast, preserving size/anchor/style, then repeat day/night/rain and gameplay zoom review.
toolChange: Catalog-key filtering added to existing review harness for focused repeated comparisons; unknown keys fail rather than silently omit entries.
